rationale: Identity was properly verified via full name + zip, and the agent correctly found the boots item and checked variant availability. The proposed change (to size 9 leather) and pricing/refund details matched tool data. However, the agent executed an order-changing write (modify_pending_order_items) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact change. The user expressed interest but did not explicitly confirm proceeding; policy requires explicit confirmation before any write. The rest of the flow (acting on the correct user, correct information, refund to original method) was acceptable, but the missing confirmation step causes the interaction to fail the pass bar.
